name: Kart Circuit
hook: Three laps, item boxes and drift boosts.
how: Drift through corners to charge a boost. Item boxes give a speed boost or a shell for whoever is just ahead. First over the line after three laps wins.
controls: Arrow keys, Shift to drift, Space for items, or on-screen buttons
uses: The fastest laps on the track.
Races start, finish and restart together for everyone.
Bots fill the grid until enough people join.
ideas: Add a second track in the snow
Add a banana you drop behind you
Let players pick a kart color before the race
